title: Rashba on Menachot
enDesc: Commentary on the Talmud written by the Rashba, Rabbi Shlomo ben Avraham ibn Aderet (1235–1310). Rashba was a student of Ramban and follows his methodology. Rashba’s commentary is characterized by the depth of analysis and his search for the pshat (contextual meaning) of the text. Rashba’s commentary includes definitive legal rulings. The text was found much later than the other volumes and there some who believe it was not written by Rashba.
